parent.prior_R46_result: 0/2 Native seeds accepted; both-OS 7680/7680 decisions match; Native backbone ablation 0; all prior world salts spent

purpose: Smallest fresh-source falsifier of whether a two-parameter learnable public-key B attention selector can recover a causal sign interaction from actual selected fifth/B consequences, where a diffuse learned reader and Native backbone were unnecessary or underoptimized in R46.

hypothesis.positive: A content-only learnable selector over OBSERVED public B action-key role states, initialized at uniform weighting and trained using factual return-derived pair labels, learns to prefer cue-tag observations above equal-and-opposite distractor observations, enabling cold long-history and cubic-law transfer with both original seeds.
hypothesis.null: The selector remains uniform or FIT-heldout/OOD underperforms, its cue/tag/fifth erasures fail to hurt it, or trained history-only/GRU controls equal or exceed it under the frozen comparison.
hypothesis.native_specific: A separately trained Native-augmented readout must show improvement on a matched data/information budget with positive backbone ablation before any Native-specific attribution; default no claim.

source.positions: SHA256 of F8-R47/panel/group/salt; distinct positions; not learner-accessible metadata
source.selected_B_encoding: Each selected B record uses _record(state_tag, selected_action, state_tag+measured_delta, context); mask auxiliary reward effect[4]=0 for every B record to prevent gate leakage
source.fifth: Actually selected PROBE=0.42 action=context; effect[0] is normalized actual after-before physical delta from original R32 law with q_sign, not unselected oracle effect
source.return_goal: (decoded observed post-action return state - 1.0)^2; no initial state added twice
source.FIT_only_probe_baseline: Estimate mean decoded selected fifth AFTER state on 16 FIT training groups, balanced sign and gate; no simulator law constant embedded in trained learner
source.positive_feasibility: Observable-tag deterministic selected physical consequence reference must achieve 0 error on all frozen cohorts or stop before learning

arms.name: learned_key_contrast
arms.init: scalar attention slope=0 (uniform); trainable positive readout gain; softmax over decoded PUBLIC B tag values; factual label CE

arms.name: uniform_key_control
arms.init: same output/calibration and readout-gain parameter, fixed zero attention slope; no privileged cue tag

arms.name: GRU_factual_control
arms.init: independently initialized GRU over same public tag/effect B sequence; q from same selected fifth and FIT offset; trainable output

arms.name: Native_augmented_key
arms.init: learned key selector plus actual R34 Native factual-memory on same raw selected a/e; trainable Native fusion; no Native-specific claim without positive ablation

methods.optimizer: AdamW(lr=0.02 for scalar key+gain, lr=0.001 for Native/GRU weights, weight_decay=0.0, grad clipping=1); single frozen schedule, no post-CAL/OOD tuning
methods.selection_mechanism: Attn weights softmax(slope * decoded selected public B key state); signed weighted B selected-delta sensor; multiply by FIT-centered decoded fifth selected following-state signal and map to public context action cost. No hidden evaluator labels or generator position.
comparison_controls: erase public cue role state tag
methods.compute: Report full-process cost, CPU wall, trainable params, optimizer steps; unmatched capacity or compute invalidates strict Native/GRU superiority.

frozen_dev_score.native_backbone_necessity_for_any_Native: OOD regret penalty >=0.08 vs own trained Native readout, plus stronger conventional gain and compute matched
frozen_dev_score.if_two_seed_failure: NO_GO preserve all scores, no retune or revisit spent OOD
frozen_dev_score.if_conventional_equal_or_better: Only basic learned mechanism, no Native-specific or broader superiority claim

qualification: Exact-final SHA full G4 Windows+Ubuntu (all prior tests unchanged), G5 Native TTT both OS, G7 pinned Mamba-2 Ubuntu, original artifacts hash-verified and 100% categorical action parity.
